name: Japan
intro: Immerse in a land where ancient temple courtyards meet neon-lit futuristic skylines. From the serene gardens of Kyoto to the bustling energy of Tokyo, Japan is a sensory masterpiece of culture, technology, and cuisine.
bestSeason: Spring (March to May) for Cherry Blossoms & Autumn (September to November) for foliage
weather: Temperate climate with four distinct seasons. Mild springs, warm humid summers (25°C to 32°C), crisp colorful autumns, and cold winters with heavy snow in northern regions.
visaInfo: Short-term tourist visa required for Indian passport holders.
flightDuration: Approx 7-8 hours direct or one-stop flight from major Indian airports.
highlights: Wander through thousands of vermilion Torii gates at Fushimi Inari in Kyoto
Gaze at the snow-capped volcanic peak of Mount Fuji from Hakone's hot springs
Navigate the futuristic streets and electronic districts of Tokyo
Ride the ultra-fast Shinkansen bullet train across the country
